# Nicholas Howell — The Workspace

> Portfolio of Nicholas Howell: CTO, founding engineer, and senior full-stack developer
> (10+ years, multiple multi-million-dollar valuations, 0 abandoned codebases). The site is
> an interactive workspace — projects in a left rail, live runnable UI components from
> each product, each project presented as a product page.

## Who

- CTO and founding engineer at AccountTouch — solely architected and shipped the platform
  (cross-platform mobile app, serverless backend, web portal).
- Helped scale a fintech startup from 3 to 20+ people into a multi-million-dollar acquisition.
- Runs the Pinnacle studio since 2019; embedded with client teams at Good Code.
- Positioning: masters AI as an accelerator and — the harder half — evaluates, hardens, and
  scales what it produces. Works greenfield or in existing codebases, solo or embedded in teams.
- Contact: nickhowell6425@gmail.com (or the in-site message drawer).

## Pages

- /: About — who you'd be working with
- /home/how-i-work: How an engagement actually looks
- /home/straight-answers: Honest FAQ
- /home/off-clock: The human running the agents
- /paradox/overview: Paradox — a full product designed and built end to end, shown as a product page: passwordless sign-up, ⌘K command palette, details panel, real-time activity, faceted filters with live counts, an interactive canvas with a 1:1 minimap, and user-generated content. Includes an FAQ on why each was built that way (e.g. magic links over passwords, guest access first).
- /paradox/demo: Paradox — the whole app as one interactive demo, running edge-to-edge (traverse the multiverse, open a timeline, fork a reality)
- /timetrack/overview: Timetrack — time tracking for the age of AI, designed and built end to end: hooks capture every AI coding session (even several running at once) and keep the data on your machine. Shown as a product page of reusable patterns: key-based sign-in without accounts, a live data-viz dashboard, an audit trail with linked proof, forms, reports frozen once sent, and a rules engine that asks instead of guessing. Includes an FAQ on why each was built that way (e.g. a key instead of accounts, failing closed when misconfigured).
- /constellation/overview: Constellation — prioritization and project planning across many clients, designed and built end to end and shown as a product page: one ranked queue across every client with tunable weights, plan branches you can diff and merge like code, ship-date forecasts with p10–p90 ranges, an inbox that turns client messages into proposed changes, a timeline and capacity view, a read-only client portal, a client workspace and onboarding. Includes an FAQ on why each was built that way (e.g. ranges instead of single dates, branches instead of a what-if mode, never messaging a client without approval).
